_about: The one place for this launcher's name, look and network addresses (docs/FORKING.md). Read at build time by launcher/src-tauri/src/branding.rs; launcher/scripts/rebrand.py copies a fork's values into the rest of launcher/.
name: Leyline

updates._updater_key: The updater's minisign public key is plugins.updater.pubkey in src-tauri/tauri.conf.json (Tauri reads it there).
updates._backup_pubkeys: Spare updater public keys (base64, as tauri.conf.json's) the owner keeps the private halves of offline: a release signed with one installs too (docs/RESILIENCE.md).

release_log._public_key: Hex Ed25519 public key of the release-log key (docs/RESILIENCE.md, 'The release key'). Empty: the release log is not trusted yet and nothing reads it.
